approval_basis: User 2026-10-03: read the official gprMax V4 manual, then run all four groups ('全跑，是2D的吧'), confirmed the series is 2D. Purpose is to test whether the unrecovered B-scan morphology is caused by insufficient boundary absorption in the air layer, as the user suspected, and to bring the vertical grid into compliance with the guide's minimum cells-per-wavelength.
invariance: Y is a single 0.05 m cell (invariant-y). Source and receiver are Ey. 2D line source, no 3D run.

solver.cubin_cache: per-run cache reusing CUBIN only for identical source, architecture and compile options; each trace reinitialises the field state

manual_reference.version_note: the live site documents 4.0.1; this run uses the fixed local 4.0.0 build and its own processing, no API upgrade
rules_applied: sources and targets at least 15 cells from the ABCs
at least 15-20 cells of free space above a source
objects spanning the computational domain are assumed to extend to infinity, so their truncation is not itself a reflection source; only ABC imperfection produces boundary reflections
discretisation step at least 10 cells per shortest wavelength, 20 preferred
placing sources or outputs inside PML cells is incorrect modelling

result.geometry_spans_domain_x: 0.000 to 12.000 m in a 12 m domain PASS

preflight_audit.consequence: The 8.31 cells per wavelength failure is why G4 exists: without it, any morphology statement carries the vertical-grid sensitivity already measured at 67.41 percent for 5 to 2.5 cm.

hypothesis_under_test.user_hypothesis: air-layer lateral reflection is affecting the received waveform
hypothesis_under_test.testable_form: boundary absorption sufficiency, not a physical lateral reflection
hypothesis_under_test.reasoning: The cover layer spans x=0 to 12 m in a 12 m domain. Under the gprMax convention, such an object extends to infinity and its truncation does not radiate; any boundary-borne wave must come from PML imperfection. This is a modelling convention, not a physical fact about the real site.
hypothesis_under_test.limit: A positive result bounds the contribution of the numerical boundary under the gprMax convention. It cannot establish or exclude lateral reflection in a real finite air layer; that would need measured data or a different model.

groups.name: domain width
groups.held_fixed: source x=5.6 z=27, receiver x=6.9 z=27, all 49 boxes, materials, Debye, cell size, PML thickness 20 cells
groups.verdict_rule: If the centre-trace underground window barely changes across 12/18/24 m, the lateral-boundary hypothesis is rejected. Today's independent domain-width control measured 1.90 percent at the centre trace, so a result near that magnitude is a rejection, not a confirmation.

groups.name: PML CFS stretching
groups.held_fixed: PML thickness 20 cells, geometry, source, receiver, cell size
groups.rationale: Thickness was deliberately NOT varied: changing thickness moves the geometric boundary and confounds absorption with layout. CFS parameters change absorption with zero geometric change.
groups.syntax_note: gprMax V4 #pml_cfs takes 12 or 13 parameters; the 12 form is used here. Verified against user_objects/cmds_multiuse.py::PMLCFS.

groups.name: air layer isolated rendering
groups.single_variable: rendering isolates z above the ground surface
groups.rationale: Lets a lateral air-layer mode be inspected directly instead of inferred from a full-domain plot.

groups.name: vertical grid refinement
groups.single_variable: dz 0.05 -> 0.025 m with all z coordinates scaled by 0.5
groups.held_fixed: dx and dy stay 0.05 m; x coordinates, source and receiver x unchanged; physical geometry preserved by scaling z
groups.pml_note: #pml_cells z0 and zmax raised to 40 so the PML keeps a 1 m physical thickness after dz halves
groups.rationale: Brings cover at 170 MHz from 8.31 to about 16.6 cells per wavelength, satisfying the guide minimum so morphology is not grid-sensitive.

snapshot_rationale: 65-130 ns covers the wavefront meeting the interface and the upward structure reported at 130 ns; 145 and 175 ns cover the period after the first interface reflection, which is where a boundary-returned wave would appear.

budget.abort_rule: Stop if a single group exceeds 45 minutes, matching the budget rule used by the earlier 0.8 m batch, and record the stop rather than relaxing the limit.

constraints: passive output only: no geometry, source, material or receiver change beyond the declared single variable per group
no training and no C5/C8 evaluation
G4, old frozen contracts, G4 training gate and prior signed conclusions are unchanged
historical outputs are never overwritten; each group writes into its own directory
acceptance: every raw H5 is float64, finite, and matches its declared V4.0.0 provenance
the recorded centre trace of G1 12 m is compared against the archived snapshot trace to confirm the run reproduces a known result
no claim of physical acceptance, spatial convergence or morphology closure is made from this batch
